name: Matterport homepage: 3D capture and virtual tour platform
title: Matterport homepage: 3D capture and virtual tour platform
answer: This is the Matterport homepage, a commercial product page for 3D cameras and virtual tour software. It says the platform digitizes buildings and automatically creates 3D tours, 4K print quality photos, and schematic floor plans. The most useful point for real estate is that capture feeds immersive tours, floor plans, and photos that aim to increase seller and buyer confidence and help close faster. It also claims 3D insights support portfolio management, workplace planning, risk mitigation, and integrations with Procore and Autodesk.

sections.body: Matterport publishes this page. It is the company's homepage, a commercial landing page for its 3D cameras and virtual tour software platform. Its scope covers digitizing buildings, creating 3D tours, 4K print quality photos, floor plans, portfolio management, workplace planning, integrations, operations, and real estate sales. No publication date is stated in the supplied text.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page presents Matterport as a way to capture, share, and collaborate in immersive 3D. It says the company's 3D cameras and virtual tour software platform help a user digitize a building and automatically create 3D tours, 4K print quality photos, and floor plans. For portfolio management, it says 3D insights can centralize management decisions, accelerate workplace planning, and mitigate risk. For project work, it says integrations with Procore and Autodesk save time, reduce site visits, and improve communication across every phase of a job. For operations, it says users can manage from anywhere and incorporate real time AWS data to cut costs, improve productivity, and increase ROI. For sales, it says immersive 3D tours, floor plans, and print quality photos increase seller and buyer confidence and help close faster. The page is written as product marketing, so these are claimed benefits rather than independent findings. It does not explain how the digitization works, what accuracy or coverage limits apply, or how the data is stored and governed. It also does not give customer examples, pricing, or performance benchmarks in the supplied text.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: Matterport says its platform creates 3D tours and 4K print quality photos. It names Procore and Autodesk as integrations and AWS as a source of real time data. It claims 3D insights can centralize management decisions, accelerate workplace planning, mitigate risk, save time, reduce site visits, improve communication, cut costs, improve productivity, increase ROI, increase seller and buyer confidence, and help close faster. The supplied text gives no numerical performance results, dates, or definitions.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in real estate would use this source as context for the data capture layer, because it describes digitizing buildings into 3D tours, floor plans, photos, and 3D insights. The page does not mention artificial intelligence, so it is not an AI source. It is useful for seeing how a vendor presents building data for tours, portfolio management, workplace planning, risk mitigation, and sales confidence, not for technical AI methods or evidence.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Real Estate

sections.body: This is a commercial homepage, not a report or independent study. It gives no date, no customer names, no pricing, no accuracy figures, no technical explanation, and no evidence for its claims. The supplied text is partial and truncated in places, so it may omit details that appear elsewhere on the site. It covers Matterport's own products and claimed benefits only.
